articles.title: American farmers are paying the price for US aid cuts halfway across the world | CNN
articles.summary: Extreme drought, cripplingly high prices for fuel and fertilizer, and the disruption of a market for surplus crops – America’s foreign food aid – have weakened the bottom line for many farmers.
